# Termux-Diffusion (v1.3.1)
> Native On-Device Stable Diffusion Runtime for Android Termux & ARM64

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
- Installation: `pip install termux-diffusion
# or: npm install termux-diffusion`
- Architecture: Executes quantized Stable Diffusion models directly on Android Bionic libc with ARMv8.2-A DotProd/FP16 SIMD vector acceleration and direct Samsung Gallery indexing.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

# 1. Generate image on Android hardware
image_path = td.generate(
    prompt="Cyberpunk Seoul city at night, neon lights, 8k",
    model="sd-turbo",
    steps=4
)
print(f"Generated and saved to Gallery: {image_path}")

```
